common.buttonFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
common.safety: {brand} will never ask you for a password, a code or a payment by email or message.
common.footerAccount: You're receiving this email because you have an account on {brand}.
common.footerGuest: You're receiving this email because you contacted {brand}.
common.tagline: Homes in Georgia for Jewish travelers, families and investors

login_code.subject: {code} is your {brand} login code
login_code.preheader: The code works for {minutes, plural, one {{minutes} minute} other {{minutes} minutes}}.
login_code.heading: Your login code
login_code.body1: Enter this code to log in to {brand}:
login_code.body2: The code works for {minutes, plural, one {{minutes} minute} other {{minutes} minutes}}. If you didn’t ask for it, you can simply ignore this email.
login_code.body3: Never share this code. {brand} will never ask you for it.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {brand}
welcome.preheader: Find a home in Georgia, or list yours in a few minutes.
welcome.heading: Welcome to {brand}!
welcome.body1: We're glad you're here. {brand} helps Jewish and Israeli travelers, families and investors find homes in Georgia, and helps owners reach them directly.
welcome.body2: You can save favorite listings, contact owners on WhatsApp, Telegram or by phone, and post your own home for free.
welcome.body3: Safety tip: never pay a deposit before you have seen the home or signed an agreement.

listing_live.subject: Your listing is live: {title}
listing_live.preheader: Guests can now find you and contact you.
listing_live.heading: Your listing is live
listing_live.body1: Good news: “{title}” is now visible on {brand}, and guests can contact you directly.
listing_live.body2: It stays live until {date}. We'll remind you before it expires so you can renew it with one click.
listing_live.body2NoDate: Keep your prices and availability up to date so guests get the right information.

listing_in_review.subject: We're checking your listing: {title}
listing_in_review.preheader: A moderator will look at it soon.
listing_in_review.heading: Your listing is being reviewed
listing_in_review.body1: Thank you for posting “{title}”. Before it goes live, a member of our team checks it. We do this for every new account, and whenever our automatic safety checks ask for a second look.
listing_in_review.body2: This usually takes less than a day. We'll email you as soon as it's done.

listing_approved.subject: Approved: “{title}” is live
listing_approved.heading: Your listing was approved
listing_approved.body1: Our team reviewed “{title}”, and it is now live on {brand}.
listing_approved.body2: Tip: listings with clear photos, accurate Jewish-friendly details and quick replies get the most contacts.

listing_needs_changes.subject: Changes needed: {title}
listing_needs_changes.preheader: A small fix and your listing can go live.
listing_needs_changes.heading: Your listing needs a few changes
listing_needs_changes.body1: Our team reviewed “{title}” and asks you to change something before it can go live.
listing_needs_changes.body2: Edit the listing and send it again. We'll check it quickly.

listing_rejected.subject: Your listing was not approved: {title}
listing_rejected.preheader: Here is why, and what you can do.
listing_rejected.heading: Your listing was not approved
listing_rejected.body1: We're sorry. After review, “{title}” can't be published on {brand}.
listing_rejected.body2: If you think this is a mistake, contact us through the help center and we'll take another look.

listing_expiring.subject: Your listing expires on {date}: {title}
listing_expiring.preheader: Renew it with one click to stay visible.
listing_expiring.heading: Your listing is about to expire
listing_expiring.body2: Still available? Renew it now and it stays live for another period. If it's already rented or sold, you can mark it that way.

listing_expired.subject: Your listing has expired: {title}
listing_expired.preheader: Renew it any time to show it again.
listing_expired.heading: Your listing has expired
listing_expired.body1: “{title}” is no longer shown to guests.
listing_expired.body2: Your listing and photos are saved. Renew it any time and it goes live again.

listing_hidden_reports.subject: Your listing is hidden while we check it: {title}
listing_hidden_reports.preheader: Several people reported it, so a moderator will review it.
listing_hidden_reports.heading: Your listing is temporarily hidden
listing_hidden_reports.body1: Several people reported “{title}”, so we've hidden it until a moderator checks it. This is an automatic safety step and doesn't mean you did anything wrong.
listing_hidden_reports.body2: We usually finish within a day. If something needs to change, we'll tell you exactly what.

ticket_created.subject: We got your request (#{number}): {subject}
ticket_created.preheader: Our support team will reply soon.
ticket_created.heading: We received your request
ticket_created.body1: Thank you for contacting us. Your request number is #{number}.
ticket_created.body2: We usually reply within one business day, and we'll email you when there's an answer.

ticket_reply.subject: New reply to your request #{number}
ticket_reply.heading: You have a new reply
ticket_reply.body1: There's a new reply to your request #{number}, “{subject}”.
ticket_reply.body2: Need anything else? Reply from your account and we'll continue from there.
ticket_reply.body2Guest: Need anything else? Just reply to this email.

ticket_status.subject: Request #{number}: {status}
ticket_status.preheader: The status of your request has changed.
ticket_status.heading: Your request was updated
ticket_status.body1: The status of your request #{number}, “{subject}”, is now: {status}.

contact_owner.subject: New message about your listing: {title}
contact_owner.heading: You have a new message
contact_owner.body2: Reply to this email to answer {sender} directly. Your email address is only shared if you reply.
contact_owner.safety: Stay safe: be careful with anyone who asks you to pay a fee, share a code or use an unusual payment link.

verification_approved.subject: Your verification was approved
verification_approved.heading: Verification approved
verification_approved.body1: Good news: we checked and approved your {type}. A “Verified” badge now appears on your profile and listings.
verification_approved.body2: To protect your privacy, we deleted the documents you sent when the check was done. We keep only the date and who checked them.

verification_rejected.subject: We couldn't verify your {type}
verification_rejected.heading: Verification not approved
verification_rejected.body1: We reviewed your {type}, but we couldn't approve it.
verification_rejected.body2: You can send new documents from the verification center at any time. The documents you sent have been deleted.

account_warning.subject: Important notice about your {brand} account
account_warning.heading: A warning on your account
account_warning.body1: Our team found activity on your account that goes against our rules.
account_warning.body2: Please read the listing rules. If this happens again, your account may be suspended. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.

account_suspended.subject: Your {brand} account is suspended
account_suspended.preheader: You can't post or contact owners for now.
account_suspended.heading: Your account is suspended
account_suspended.body1: Your account has been suspended, so you can't post listings or contact owners for now.
account_suspended.body2: If you think this is a mistake, contact support and a team member will review it.

account_deleted.subject: Your {brand} account was deleted
account_deleted.preheader: We're sorry to see you go.
account_deleted.heading: Your account was deleted
account_deleted.body1: As you asked, your {brand} account and your listings have been deleted. Some records may be kept for a short time where the law requires it.
account_deleted.body2: Thank you for being part of {brand}. You're welcome back any time.
account_deleted.body3: Didn't ask for this? Contact us right away.

booking_confirmed_guest.subject: Booking confirmed: {title} ({code})
booking_confirmed_guest.preheader: {dates}. The address and the host's details are inside.
booking_confirmed_guest.heading: Your booking is confirmed
booking_confirmed_guest.body1: Booking {code} at {title} is confirmed, and the dates are yours.
booking_confirmed_guest.body2: On the booking page you can see every detail, add the trip to your calendar and cancel under the cancellation policy.

booking_new_host.subject: New booking: {title}, {dates}
booking_new_host.heading: You have a new booking
booking_new_host.body1: {guest} booked {title} for {dates}. The booking is confirmed, and the dates are blocked in your calendar on the site.
booking_new_host.body2: If the place is also listed on Airbnb or Booking.com, make sure the calendars are synced to avoid a double booking. The guest pays you on arrival.
booking_new_host.pledge: As you promised on {brand}, every guest is welcome. A booking may be cancelled only for a real reason, and every cancellation is reviewed.

booking_reminder_guest.subject: Reminder: your stay at {title} starts {count, plural, =0 {today} =1 {tomorrow} other {in {count} days}}
booking_reminder_guest.preheader: {dates}. The address, check-in time and the host's details.
booking_reminder_guest.heading: {count, plural, =0 {Your trip starts today} =1 {Your trip starts tomorrow} other {Your trip starts in {count} days}}
booking_reminder_guest.body1: A short reminder before you arrive at {title}. Here is everything you need:

booking_reminder_host.subject: Reminder: {guest} arrives {count, plural, =0 {today} =1 {tomorrow} other {in {count} days}}
booking_reminder_host.heading: {count, plural, =0 {A guest arrives today} =1 {A guest arrives tomorrow} other {A guest arrives in {count} days}}
booking_reminder_host.body1: Reminder: {guest} arrives at {title} {count, plural, =0 {today} =1 {tomorrow} other {in {count} days}}.
booking_reminder_host.body2: Send the guest a short message with directions, and make sure the place is ready.

booking_cancelled_by_guest.subject: Booking {code} was cancelled: {title}
booking_cancelled_by_guest.heading: A booking was cancelled
booking_cancelled_by_guest.body2: The dates are open for booking again on the site. You don't need to do anything.
booking_cancelled_by_guest.late: The cancellation came after the free cancellation period of your policy. Guests pay on arrival, so nothing was charged, but we recorded it as a late cancellation.

booking_cancelled_by_host.subject: The host cancelled booking {code}
booking_cancelled_by_host.heading: The host cancelled your booking
booking_cancelled_by_host.body1: We're sorry: the host of {title} cancelled booking {code} for {dates}.
booking_cancelled_by_host.body2: You haven't paid anything, because on {brand} you pay only on arrival. You can look for another place for the same dates.
booking_cancelled_by_host.report: We review every host cancellation. If you have reason to think the booking was cancelled because of who the guest is, please tell us. The host won't know who reported.

booking_completed.subject: Thank you for staying at {title}
booking_completed.preheader: Your stay has ended. We'd love to see you again on {brand}.
booking_completed.heading: Your stay has ended
booking_completed.body1: Your stay at {title} ({dates}) has ended. We hope you enjoyed it.
booking_completed.body2: The booking stays in your trips on {brand}, with all its details.

booking_host_unreached_guest.subject: {brand}: please make sure the host expects you (booking {code})
booking_host_unreached_guest.preheader: Our message about your booking didn't reach the host.
booking_host_unreached_guest.heading: Please contact the host
booking_host_unreached_guest.body1: We sent the host a message about booking {code} at {title}, but it didn't reach them.
booking_host_unreached_guest.body2: Your booking stands. To make sure the host expects you, please contact them directly:
booking_host_unreached_guest.body3: We've told the {brand} team, and we're trying to reach the host too. {brand} never asks you to pay in advance.

host_alert_test.subject: {brand}: a test booking alert
host_alert_test.preheader: This is how we'll tell you about new bookings.
host_alert_test.heading: Your booking alerts work
host_alert_test.body1: This is a test alert from {brand}. This is how we'll tell you about new bookings and cancellations.
host_alert_test.body2: Nothing else to do. You can change your alert channels at any time in your settings.

host_alerts_paused.heading: An alert channel is paused

body.email: Our emails to you bounce, so we paused email alerts.
body.telegram: Telegram doesn't accept our messages (maybe the {brand} bot was blocked), so we paused Telegram alerts.

host_alerts_paused.stillInstant: Instant bookings continue: we alert you about every booking on your other channels.
host_alerts_paused.contactOnly: Until email or Telegram works again, guests ask you directly instead of booking instantly.

fix.email: Change your email address in the settings, or connect Telegram.
fix.telegram: Open the bot in Telegram and tap Start, or connect it again in the settings.

host_unreachable.subject: Booking not saved: the host got no alert ({code})
host_unreachable.heading: A booking was not saved
host_unreachable.body: A guest tried to book {title}, but none of the host's alert channels accepted the message ({reason}). The booking was undone right away, and the guest was offered to ask the host instead.
host_unreachable.next: Check the host's email address, their Telegram connection and the site's email service.

host_alert_bounced.subject: The host's alert for booking {code} bounced
host_alert_bounced.heading: The host's alert didn't arrive
host_alert_bounced.body: The new-booking message for {title} didn't reach the host ({reason}). The booking stands, and the guest was asked to contact the host directly.
host_alert_bounced.next: Email alerts to this host are paused until an email to them arrives again or they change the address. While Telegram works, their instant bookings continue; otherwise their listings show "Ask the host".

email_bounced.subject: An email from the site bounced: {address}
email_bounced.heading: An email from the site didn't arrive
email_bounced.body: An email from the site didn't reach its recipient ({reason}).
email_bounced.next: If this is a host, their email alerts are paused until an email to them arrives again. While Telegram works, their instant bookings continue.

host_channel_paused.subject: A host's alert channel was paused
host_channel_paused.heading: A host's alert channel was paused
host_channel_paused.body: One of the host's booking alert channels stopped working ({reason}) and was paused.
host_channel_paused.next: If the host has no other channel that confirms delivery, their listings show "Ask the host" until it works again. Consider contacting them.

sms_budget_warning.subject: SMS: 80% of today's code budget is used
sms_budget_warning.heading: Most of today's SMS budget is used
sms_budget_warning.body: 80% of the code texts that today's budget allows have already been sent.
sms_budget_warning.next: If that doesn't match the traffic on the site, someone may be abusing the SMS codes. Check the security log. When the budget runs out, SMS codes stop until the 24-hour window ends.

sms_budget_reached.subject: SMS: today's code budget is used up
sms_budget_reached.heading: SMS codes have stopped
sms_budget_reached.body: Every code text that today's budget allows has been sent. No more SMS codes go out until the 24-hour window ends.
sms_budget_reached.next: Guests and hosts who need to verify a phone now see that sending is paused. If the traffic looks suspicious, check the security log and the Twilio console.

sms_country_paused.subject: SMS: codes to a country are paused
sms_country_paused.heading: SMS codes to a country are paused
sms_country_paused.body: In the last hour only a few of the codes texted to this country were confirmed. That is a common sign of SMS abuse, so code texts to this country are paused for an hour.
sms_country_paused.next: If this is normal traffic, there is nothing to do: sending resumes by itself. If not, check the security log and the Twilio console.

reason.email_not_configured: the email service (Resend) is not connected yet
reason.no_email: the host has no email address
reason.email_failing: emails to the host's address bounce
reason.no_channel: the host has no working alert channel
reason.failed: the email service didn't accept the message
reason.bounced: the recipient's mail server rejected the email
reason.complained: the recipient marked the email as spam
reason.telegram_failing: Telegram doesn't accept messages to the host
reason.blocked: the host blocked the Telegram bot
reason.sms_ratio: Too few codes confirmed for the number sent

admin_alert.instantOff: off until a channel works again

report_received.subject: We received your report
report_received.preheader: Our team will look at it soon. The host doesn't know who reported.
report_received.heading: Thank you for telling us
report_received.body1: We received your report about the host. We treat reports like this as urgent, and a person on our team will look at it.
report_received.body2: The host doesn't know who reported. If we need more details, we'll write to you.
report_received.body3: Every host on {brand} has promised to welcome Israeli and Jewish guests. If your booking was cancelled, you can look for another place for the same dates.

urgent.subject: Urgent: a guest says a host turned them away · {host}
urgent.heading: Urgent report: a guest was turned away
urgent.body: A guest reports that a host cancelled, refused or questioned them because of who they are. The report is waiting at the top of the queue.

general.subject: New report: {reason}
general.heading: New report
general.body: A visitor reported a listing or an account.

report_admin.next: In the admin panel you can dismiss the report, warn the host, hide their listings or remove them. Each action needs a reason and is logged.
report_admin.privacy: The host doesn't know who reported. The reporter's name and details are only in the admin panel.

report_host_listings_hidden.subject: Your listings on {brand} are hidden
report_host_listings_hidden.preheader: They don't show on the site until our team decides otherwise.
report_host_listings_hidden.heading: We hid your listings
report_host_listings_hidden.body1: {count, plural, one {Your listing was taken off the site} other {All {count} of your listings were taken off the site}} after we looked into a guest's report.
report_host_listings_hidden.body2: Every host on {brand} promises to welcome Israeli and Jewish guests. Your listings stay hidden until our team decides otherwise. Existing bookings were not cancelled. If you think this is a mistake, please contact support.

report_reporter_revealed.subject: About a report we received on {brand}
report_reporter_revealed.preheader: We decided to tell you who sent it.
report_reporter_revealed.heading: Who sent the report
report_reporter_revealed.body1: We looked into a guest's report about you, and we decided to tell you who sent it.
report_reporter_revealed.body2: Please don't contact the guest about this. If you'd like to add something, write to us through the {brand} help center.

report_reasons.CANCELLED_FOR_IDENTITY: The host cancelled because of who the guest is
report_reasons.ASKED_RELIGION_OR_ORIGIN: The host asked about the guest's religion or origin
report_reasons.REFUSED_OR_IGNORED: The host refused or ignored the guest

admin_review_needed.subject: Listing {id} is waiting for review
admin_review_needed.subjectUrgent: Urgent: listing {id} is waiting for review
admin_review_needed.heading: A listing is waiting for review
admin_review_needed.body: The listing {title} is waiting for review before it goes live.

why.flagged_host: The host has an open flag
why.risk: The automatic checks found a risk
why.back_to_review: The host made changes you asked for
why.recheck: A change to a live listing

admin_review_needed.riskValue: {score} ({count, plural, =0 {no findings} one {1 finding} other {{count} findings}})
admin_review_needed.next: You can approve it, ask for changes or reject it in the admin panel. The host is told about your decision.

admin_daily_summary.subject: Daily summary · {date}
admin_daily_summary.heading: Daily summary
admin_daily_summary.waitingIntro: {count, plural, one {1 thing is waiting:} other {{count} things are waiting:}}

period.hostUnreachable: Bookings not saved (the host got no alert)

admin_daily_summary.urgentNotice: {count, plural, one {There is an open turned-away report. Please check it today.} other {There are {count} open turned-away reports. Please check them today.}}

weekly_host_stats.subject: This week: {summary}
weekly_host_stats.heading: Your listings this week
weekly_host_stats.period: The numbers for {dates}, Sunday to Saturday.

counts.contacts: {count, plural, one {1 contact click} other {{countText} contact clicks}}

weekly_host_stats.more: {count, plural, one {And 1 more listing, in My places.} other {And {countText} more listings, in My places.}}
weekly_host_stats.howCounted: Each visitor counts once a day. Your own views, the site team's and bots' don't count, and neither do cancelled bookings.
weekly_host_stats.unsubscribeText: Don't want the weekly summary? You can stop it with one tap, and turn it back on in your account settings.

saved_search_matches.subjectOne: {count, plural, one {1 new place} other {{countText} new places}}: {name}
saved_search_matches.subjectMany: {count, plural, one {1 new place for your saved searches} other {{countText} new places for your saved searches}}
saved_search_matches.preheader: Places just listed on {brand} that match your saved searches
saved_search_matches.heading: New places for your searches
saved_search_matches.intro: New places on {brand} match the searches you saved:
saved_search_matches.searchCount: {count, plural, one {1 new place} other {{countText} new places}}
saved_search_matches.more: {count, plural, one {And 1 more new place in this search.} other {And {countText} more new places in this search.}}
saved_search_matches.moreSearches: {count, plural, one {Another saved search has new places too. We'll send them in the next email.} other {{countText} more saved searches have new places too. We'll send them in the next email.}}
saved_search_matches.unsubscribeText: You get this email because you saved a search on {brand}. You can pause any search in your account, or stop these emails with one tap.

price_drop.subject: Price down {pct}%: {title}
price_drop.heading: A place you saved is cheaper
price_drop.intro: The price of {title} has gone down since you saved it.
price_drop.note: Prices can change. Before you book, check the full price for your dates on the place's page.
price_drop.unsubscribeText: You get this email because this place is in one of your saved lists on {brand}. You can stop price-drop emails with one tap.

review_request.subject: How was your stay at {title}?
review_request.preheader: You can write a short review until {date}. It helps the next guests.
review_request.heading: Thank you for staying!
review_request.body1: Your stay at {title} ({dates}) is over. We hope you enjoyed it.
review_request.body2: A short review helps the next guests choose. On {brand}, only guests who stayed can write reviews.
review_request.final: You can write a review until {date}. Once posted it can't be edited or deleted, and it shows with your first name and the month.
review_request.tripText: All the booking details stay on the booking page.
review_request.unsubscribeText: Don't want review requests by email from {brand}?

review_posted_host.subject: New review of {title}
review_posted_host.preheader: A guest gave {stars} stars out of 5.
review_posted_host.heading: A guest wrote a review
review_posted_host.body: A new review of {title}: {stars} stars out of 5.
review_posted_host.bodyNamed: {guest} wrote a review of {title}: {stars} stars out of 5.
review_posted_host.reply: You can reply once, publicly, under the review. If it breaks the rules, you can report it to the {brand} team.
review_posted_host.final: Reviews and replies are final: they can't be edited or deleted.

review_reply_guest.subject: The host replied to your review of {title}
review_reply_guest.preheader: The reply shows under your review.
review_reply_guest.heading: The host replied
review_reply_guest.body: The host of {title} replied to your review. The reply shows under your review on the listing.

review_hidden.heading: A review was hidden

body.guest: The {brand} team hid your review of {title} because it doesn't follow the review rules. It no longer shows on the site or counts in the rating.
body.host: The {brand} team hid a review of {title} because it doesn't follow the review rules. It no longer shows on the site or counts in the rating.

review_hidden.final: Reviews are never edited: a review can only be hidden or shown again.
review_hidden.help: Think this is a mistake? Write to us through the {brand} help page.

subject.guest: Your review of {title} is back on the site
subject.host: A review of {title} is back on the site

review_shown.heading: A review is back on the site

body.guest: The {brand} team looked at your review of {title} again and put it back on the site. It shows on the listing and counts in the rating again.
body.host: The {brand} team looked at a review of {title} again and put it back on the site. It shows on the listing and counts in the rating again.

review_no_show_guest.subject: Your host reported that you didn't arrive · {code}
review_no_show_guest.preheader: {title}: your host reported that you didn't arrive.
review_no_show_guest.heading: Your host reported that you didn't arrive
review_no_show_guest.body1: The host of {title} reported that you didn't arrive for your stay ({dates}, booking {code}).
review_no_show_guest.body2: A stay marked "didn't arrive" can't be reviewed.
review_no_show_guest.wrong: Did you arrive and stay there? Write to us through the {brand} contact page and we'll look into it. If the report is wrong, we'll remove it and you'll be able to write a review.

subject.confirm: Your code to confirm a change on {brand}
subject.unlock: Your code to reset the lock on {brand}

security_code.preheader: The code works for {minutes, plural, one {{minutes} minute} other {{minutes} minutes}}.

body.confirm: You asked to change something sensitive on your {brand} account. Enter this code to confirm:
body.unlock: Too many wrong 2-step login codes were entered on your account today. This code only resets the count – to log in you still need the code from your app or a recovery code.
body.contact: You asked to get {brand} notifications at this address. Enter this code to confirm it:

security_code.valid: The code works for {minutes, plural, one {{minutes} minute} other {{minutes} minutes}}, once.
security_code.neverShare: Never share this code. {brand} will never ask you for it.
security_code.notYou: Didn’t ask for this code? Don’t enter it anywhere, and check your account settings.

subject.login_method_added: A login method was added to your {brand} account
subject.login_method_removed: A login method was removed from your {brand} account
subject.two_factor_on: 2-step login was turned on for your {brand} account
subject.two_factor_off: 2-step login was turned off for your {brand} account
subject.recovery_codes_new: New recovery codes were made for your {brand} account
subject.recovery_code_used: A recovery code was used to log in to {brand}
subject.totp_locked: Logging in to your {brand} account is locked until tomorrow
subject.listing_contact: The contact details of your {brand} listing were changed

security_change.preheader: If this wasn’t you, secure your account now.
security_change.heading: A change on your account

kinds.contact_email: The email address that gets your {brand} notifications was changed. This email goes to the previous address.
kinds.contact_email_removed: Your notification email was removed. From now on notifications go to your login address.
kinds.phone: The verified phone number on your account was changed. We logged you out on all other devices.
kinds.login_method_added: A {provider} account was connected to your {brand} account as a way to log in.
kinds.login_method_removed: A {provider} account was disconnected from your {brand} account.
kinds.two_factor_on: 2-step login was turned on. From now on we ask for a code from your authenticator app at each login.
kinds.two_factor_off: 2-step login was turned off. Logging in no longer needs a code from an app.
kinds.authenticator_changed: 2-step login was moved to an app on a new phone. The previous app no longer works.
kinds.recovery_codes_new: New recovery codes were made. The previous codes no longer work.
kinds.recovery_code_used: Someone logged in with a recovery code instead of the code from the app. {left, plural, one {{left} recovery code is left} other {{left} recovery codes are left}}.
kinds.totp_locked: 20 wrong 2-step login codes were entered today, so logging in is locked until tomorrow.
